verdict.rationale: Phaser ships its own hosted Game Agent. Its page invites prompts like "What game do you want me to make?" and accepts plain-language requests such as "Give the player a double-jump and a coin counter… make gravity stronger." The Phaser Editor page describes an in-editor assistant that "handles" tasks like creating particle emitters, reorganising scenes into layers and renaming objects "without switching tools." It also positions the MCP server as the deeper option "for power users", which implies a built-in assistant exists alongside it. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the editor's built-in assistant (the editor copy never explicitly names it as AI), clear documentation of the hosted agent's scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works.
